events.summary: Opened a dedicated critical-edition package for Song of Enlightenment.
Recorded the inherited local anthology witness, scoped additional exact witness leads, and initialized all required process surfaces.
Confirmed a standalone 1694 NDL witness, a broader Commons exact-witness family, a second anthology-style exact lead, and early commentary controls.
Converted the current witness leads into dedicated witness folders and split the Wenzhou exact family into file-level child witnesses.
Added the remaining surfaced Wenzhou exact file and logged a second-wave commentary-family docket for future acquisition.
Added a further exact Wenzhou file outside the initial category slice, a 1935 bibliographic exact lead, and a late commentary bibliographic lead.
Added a Waseda digital mirror lead, recorded a Wenzhou-to-Waseda duplicate relation from Commons logs, and removed the prohibited canonical web control from package witness surfaces.
A five-agent witness wave added Korean exact leads, independent Japanese anthology witnesses, and a Japanese manuscript exact witness.
A second five-agent witness wave added further Korean exact-title leads, a derivative anthology branch, and an older Japanese commentary lead.
Ranked the independent exact witness families, established a first-tier acquisition queue, and demoted duplicate-risk and derivative branches before the next targeted scan hunt.
A targeted five-agent scan-gap hunt revised the first-tier queue, confirmed new Japanese image-backed exact standalones, and clarified which Wenzhou and Korean branches are truly independent.

Downloaded the directly accessible Commons-backed first-tier exact tranche into the package and isolated the remaining first-tier witnesses as capture-path blockers rather than witness-discovery gaps.

A further five-agent online witness sweep added additional Japanese anthology and exact leads, stronger Korean digital surfaces, and more scan-backed control witnesses without changing the first-tier exact core.
A six-agent capture push brought in the Korean 1474 exact PDF and the Toyo and Berkeley IIIF manifests, while isolating YJG-W9 and YJG-W12 as the remaining first-tier capture blockers.
Harvested full IIIF page-image tranches for the Toyo and Berkeley exact witnesses and logged additional scan-backed witness leads from the concurrent five-agent search wave.
Captured the Korean 1647 exact witness through its direct public PDF path and added a newly surfaced Korean 1576 exact witness to the held first-tier family.
A further five-agent hunt confirmed YJG-W12 remains metadata-only, captured direct public manifests for YJG-W19 and YJG-W20, and opened a new Berkeley 1672 四部録 control.
Harvested the full exposed image tranche for YJG-W19, upgraded the IIIF helper for v2 and v3 manifests, and completed the slower resumable image harvest for YJG-W20.
A final five-agent scan review failed to uncover a materially new exact branch, so the package re-ranked the held exact core and pruned overlapping anthology controls.

Re-read the binding edition protocols after ReadZen-side critical-edition support advanced and moved the package into OCR-first preflight with mandatory tiered evidence capture, anchor transparency fields, and Paddle word-box support requirements.

A five-agent post-preflight witness wave added a new 1641 NIJL exact standalone lead, three exact fragmentary NIJL witnesses, one new Korean metadata-only exact line, one image-backed Korean exact branch lead, and several new Kyushu / Kyoto control branches while also resolving stronger direct asset paths for older Korean backup leads.
The same wave established that YJG-W18 is not independent from the held 1694 line, and that YJG-W12 and YJG-W7 remain blocked or bibliographic-only rather than latent public-scan wins.
Captured and fully harvested the NIJL 1641 exact witness YJG-W22, and manifest-ingested plus fully harvested the Kyushu control witnesses YJG-A10 and YJG-A11.
Expanded OCR tranche 1 to include the newly held exact witness YJG-W22 while keeping YJG-A10 and YJG-A11 as second-tier controls and keeping the fragmentary NIJL exact witnesses out of tranche 1.
